solver_configuration: unmodified defaults; record exposed settings, do not claim an unexposed default seed
required_observations: Binary resolved path, version response, SHA-256, Python/platform and git commit/dirty state.
Exact DIMACS bytes, command array, exit code, stdout/stderr, monotonic elapsed time, start/end timestamps, and actual memory observation or explicit unavailable reason.
Independently enumerate all assignments for each fixture and compare to the frozen set.
Parse SAT models and check every clause independently; UNSAT is confirmed only for these tiny fixtures by complete truth-table enumeration.
No retry and no replacement fixture. Timeout/crash/missing model is a recorded tooling failure, never mathematical evidence.
temporary_files: Use a private temporary directory for literal DIMACS files; embed exact bytes in transcript.json. Do not write other repository files.
implementation: Write a small standard-library Python runner in run_controls.py, then execute it once. Treat CaDiCaL exit 10/20 as solver results, not generic subprocess failures.
report_scope: Readiness for the exact installed binary and three fixtures only; no Semaev encoding, XOR-native reasoning, performance ratio, attack cost or scientific hypothesis claim.
inference_provenance: Record requested policy and effort; native model null/unverified if no exact identifier is exposed.
